## Manual browser-ticket login (Cloudflare fallback)

Garmin's Cloudflare protection can block the automated email/password login outright. This release adds a manual fallback that logs in with a CAS service ticket captured from your own already-authenticated browser session, which passes Cloudflare because it is a real, human login.

- **`garmin auth --manual`** — interactive: prints a URL to open and a one-line browser-console snippet that copies a login ticket, then prompts you to paste it.
